customer_updates.name: Rajeet Gangopadhyay
customer_updates.text: Harry! Thank you so much for the lovely experience🫡🫶🌴🌳🌲🙏🌈🌵🐞🐌🐝🌅☮️☮️☮️

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Sortey
featured_reviews.review_text: Went for the first time to ride in the park. Harry is super accommodative and they keep their bicycles in top shape. They even gave us matching colours! Highly recommend getting in touch with them if you are looking for a leisurely ride through the park. Amazing experience

featured_reviews.name: Neeta Vijayan
featured_reviews.review_text:
They have worn down and poorly maintained cycle. The seat no matter how well you adjust you can't do much about it. Don't even ask me how poor the brakes are (SGNP has lot of elevations and it's Risky with poor brakes). Once you take this into park you can't go back and change it. The staff is very unruly nearly rowdies and they overcharge like crazy as they know they are the only ones in the vicinity. I swear I am never gonna take the kids there.

I wouldn't even give them 1 rating but then that's for the money I paid.

Absolute nightmare. I think the management has changed as the person who used to handle it earlier was a great guy and he was quite good at customer service. The leeches who sit their and near the park have ruined the experience for us..

So charges are like this:

Ordinary cycle - 120 per hour
MTB - 150 per hour
Deposit that they take is around 500 or depending on the cycles you take.
They ask you to leave Original ID proof at the shop when you rent.

Now here is the game, even if you want it only for 1 hour their minimum charge is for 2 hrs. They know by the time you go inside and start cycling 30 mins to 45 mins are lost after the booking time. They use the clock outside the park hanging up. With kids trust me you will not step out anywhere around in 2.5 to 3hrs.

So we came out by 2.5 hrs. They say it's ok to be late by 10-15 mins but don't buy that because the moment you come to hand over he is gonna charge for 1 HR extra.

So they charged me 1560 for 4 cycles. Do that math. For 1 cycle which I rented 15 mins later after much haggle he didn't charge. He makes a fortune.

After all this because we came by bike, the park charged us parking charges, the ticket charges including another charge for getting the cycle in the park. All in all I felt drained.

So trust me both SGNP AND THESE SCAM CYCLE RENTERS ARE IN COHORTS TO SCAM PEOPLE OF THEIR HARD EARNED MONEY.

If you still want to go, take your own cycles then you only pay for the cycle ticket at SGNP gate. You could try and park the vehicles somewhere nearby where you won't be charged and cops won't tow it away. Otherwise this is not worth it.

A much better option to SGNP with equally good experience of nature is Manoril hills and Gorai beach via Ferry. Remains my favourite till date.

featured_reviews.name: Jaqueline Mendonca
featured_reviews.review_text: Some first experiences does turn out to be the best! No regrets at Harry bicycle rental. They legit offered me and my group with tangible (bicycles) and non-tangible (customer servicing and handling) services. And to add to it, they make themselves available to you anywhere and everywhere and anytime! Also, how active can rentals be? Well, this one is! They are event organisers too. So you've got it all under one roof there. All the Harry bicycle rental and continue with the rigour, Harry!

featured_reviews.name: Beverly N
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a superb experience with Harry's shop. He was very helpful and he makes sure to check in with all his customers. I've rented bicycles from him 5 times and each time the experience has been awesome. Going to keep coming here.

featured_reviews.name: Jeethesh Kotian
featured_reviews.review_text:
Horrible experience!!! One of the most horibble experience I had with any services where the owner almost had us beaten up by his employee along with bad words given to us. That too for just coming late for 15 mins. That guy with big hair has no manners and acts as a roudy. He has some horrible cycle for rent and when you drag the cycle because of broken chain this guys will charge you extra for time. That is still fine but the way he handles client is like they want to keep all the deposit that you give. Please don't go here if you don't what to fight at end of your wonderful trip in SGNP. Check other 1 star comments and reply you will get to know their service.
Also I am expecting a weird, unrelated and harsh bulling reply from the owner on this feedback. Watch it as he does this for all genuine comments.

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Bobade
featured_reviews.review_text: Just visited this place today morning and had an awesome tine. Harry's cycle can be rented just at the entry of the national park. The cycles are well maintained and available at reasonable rates. He also arranges for trails through national park. Amazing guy to chat with.. Worth a try of you are exploring the park.🤟

featured_reviews.name: Sailee Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text: Wish to pedal but do not have a bicycle?oh you do wish to pedal but do not want to own one no issues there is always a solution and that solution is Mr. Harry.And guess what he is right outside the place where pedalling would be more fun and refreshing.That reviving place is Sanjay Gandhi National Park.Me along with my sister-in-law decided to go cycling in the national park over a weekend in September,2018.Till we reached the gate we were unaware of the rental bicycles from outside the park.Minimal rental process,agreeable charges and more over bicycles with good conditions. Back then the number of bicycles were limited but when i revisited in February 2019 i was glad to see that the number of cycles in his store had increased.One can assume the demand from that.Though expanded but has maintained the quality/condition.The bicycles can be booked on phone as well.Thank you Harry for starting such a much needed system.Good luck!

featured_reviews.review_text: A very friendly and helpful owner. Had a good experience. A few tips for tourists: 1) have your ID copy or photo with you for a deposit 2) the shop is located behind the Omarekshwar temple on the other side of the road from the park entrance, but at the entry you will most probably meet a guy with the bikes who will help you to find it.

featured_reviews.name: Omkar Salagare
featured_reviews.review_text:
Being a first time buyer and being new to this. I recently purchased a Studds helmet from this store, and at the time of purchase, the owner made very strong claims like “whatever happens, just come to me, I’ll get it repaired.”

Unfortunately, when I faced an issue, that assurance turned out to be completely misleading.

To be fair, I understand the damage happened due to heat exposure from my bike’s silencer, so it may not fall under standard warranty. However, the problem here is not just the product—it’s the false commitment made at the time of sale.

Customers rely on the words of the seller while making a purchase. Giving unrealistic promises just to close a sale is highly unprofessional and breaks trust.

I would strongly advise future buyers to rely only on official warranty terms and not verbal assurances from the store.

Very disappointing experience.

What truly impressed me was their willingness to dispatch the helmet for delivery even before the payment reached their accounts. This gesture reflects not only their trust but also their commitment to customer satisfaction.

Raj and Shyam demonstrated remarkable speed, courtesy, and business acumen. Their gentle approach and quick service show that they truly understand both business and customer care. It is rare to find such dedication, and I am grateful for their support.
